Message:
feat(Sky): Add OnAction callback to ShowNotification bridge handler

The ShowNotification function in InstallUiRequests had `actions` typed as `unknown` and lacked an `OnAction` callback, preventing DOM toast round-trip resolution with action-button responses. Extensions invoking ShowNotification received no feedback when users clicked notification actions.

Type `actions` as `string[]` and add the `OnAction` callback parameter that fires with the selected action label (or null on auto-dismiss). This completes the notification round-trip plumbing described in the preceding workbench services integration.

Notification actions now resolve correctly through the Mountain oneshot mechanism, matching VS Code's expected behaviour.
